# Rename "Data Science Projects" navigation label to "Projects"

## Description

Shorten the user-facing label "Data Science Projects" to "Projects" everywhere it appears in the Dashboard UI — navigation menu, page headings, and other in-page references to the same feature. Usability testing showed the long label confuses users arriving from OpenShift, where the same resources are already called projects. Product management has approved the change. No behavior, routing, or API changes are involved.

## Scope

- Update the navigation menu label for the Data Science Projects section to "Projects".
- Update page headings and other user-visible strings in the Dashboard that display the "Data Science Projects" label so they consistently read "Projects".
- Update documentation screenshots' captions and references to the old label in the affected topics so docs match the new UI text (no new documentation content is authored).
- Out of scope: renaming the underlying Kubernetes resources or CRDs; localization string review beyond the changed label.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Given the Dashboard is loaded, when a user views the navigation menu, then the section previously labeled "Data Science Projects" is labeled "Projects".
- Given a user navigates to the projects area, when the page renders, then the page heading and related in-page text show "Projects" instead of "Data Science Projects".
- Given the affected documentation topics, when the new UI text is in place, then captions and textual references to the old label are updated to match (screenshots regenerated/updated where the old label is visible).
- No changes to routing, API behavior, or Kubernetes resource/CRD names — verified by regression of existing navigation and project CRUD flows.

## HLR Traceability

- HLR-1 (P2): Dashboard navigation and page headings show "Projects" — covered by this epic's UI string changes.
- HLR-2 (P2): Documentation captions/references updated in affected topics — covered by this epic's incidental documentation touch-ups.
